chapter three · from the heart

A letter, just for you

Happy Birthday, Swarnim! ❤️

Today is all about celebrating you, and I hope you know how genuinely special you are.

Sometimes, we meet people who slowly become an important part of our lives without even realizing it. They bring smiles into ordinary days, make conversations more enjoyable, and leave behind little moments that are worth remembering. For me, you're one of those people.

I'm really glad to have you as a friend. There's something special about having someone whose presence can make a day feel a little better. And even if I don't always say it, I truly appreciate you and the place you have in my life.

On your birthday, I wish you so much more than just happiness for one day. I hope this new year of your life brings you peace when things get difficult, courage when you doubt yourself, success in everything you work towards, and countless reasons to smile. I hope you meet people who appreciate your heart, support your dreams, and treat you with the kindness you deserve.

Never feel that you have to be perfect to be wonderful. Keep being yourself, keep growing, keep laughing at the little things, and keep chasing the things that make you happy. You deserve friendships that feel genuine, memories that make you smile years later, and a future that makes you proud of how far you've come.

And one more thing: thank you for being you. Thank you for the little moments, the conversations, and the simple fact that our paths crossed. Maybe I don't always find the right words to express appreciation, but that doesn't mean it isn't there.

I hope this birthday becomes one of those beautiful memories you look back on with a smile. No matter how busy life gets or how much things change, I hope you never forget that you are appreciated, valued, and genuinely wished the very best.

Happy Birthday once again, Swarnim. Keep smiling, keep shining, and never stop being the wonderful person you are. 💗

— Alfatah ♡

the final little secret
🌙 ✨ ♡

Keep being you.

I know this is just a little birthday website, but I wanted to do something different for you — something that could make you smile and remind you that you're an important person in someone's life.

You don't have to do anything special to deserve appreciation. Sometimes, simply being the person you are is enough. ♡

I'm grateful to have you as my friend, and I hope this little surprise brings a smile to your face today. Keep this birthday close to your heart, keep believing in yourself, and always remember how much good you deserve in life. Stay happy. Stay amazing. And never stop being Swarnim. ❤️

With lots of care,
Alfatah ♡
